title: Appointed as Assistant
original: It is an honor to serve you, Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: I was once naive enough to think I could have anything I wanted. Now I know, while that may be true for most things, it is not for others. Those I can never get. Not on my own.

title: Talk 2
original: Any work you might have, please feel free to let me try. Don't worry, after what I've have been through, the dignity of a noblewoman is the least of my concerns. Now I am just like Zima and the girls, an ordinary student under protection.

title: Talk 3
original: Doctor, if you would like to know more about Chernobog, I may be able to provide a unique perspective. I was only a student, but you know, the Student Council President does interact with society at large, in some ways.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: People like Istina, who forgo the opiate that is entertainment in pursuit of greater knowledge, are quite rare. Even at a noble school like I attended. If she had been my classmate back then... No, it's no use thinking about that now.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: To hate the world on account of a tragedy is as shortsighted as loving the world over a comedy——Is it? Doctor, have you already decided how to handle all that you will soon face? And how should I? I'm still unsure.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, I have a favor to ask of you. Would you please look after Zima and the girls... specifically their mental health? They look like they're adjusting well, but I know they're not. Even I, occasionally, think back to those times...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, I wonder if you could ever understand? I was a victim, at times, I know. But at some point, I found myself an unconscious victimizer. And I even… 'indulged' in it... I... I can never forgive myself for that.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, is it easier to forget, when you're fully grown? When I come of age, will I be able to forgive myself? Will becoming as mature as you allow me to finally deal with the misery in my heart?

title: Idle
original: The Doctor is asleep...  Looks kind of cute.

title: Onboard
original: Greetings, Doctor. Allow me to once again express my gratitude to Rhodes Island for taking in me and my friends. I've had enough of a break working in Logistics, and I'd like to do as Zima and the girls do.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I too must prepare for the battlefield…

title: Promotion 1
original: It seems my experience in student government is paying dividends in my work life. How delightful.

title: Promotion 2
original: There is still much I don't understand about what I am doing, about my future, about myself, and about so much more. But I am young. I still have time to think. Don't I, Doctor?

title: Added to Squad
original: Let us put my training to the test.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I will do all I can.

title: Depart
original: Comrades, let us move out.

title: Begin Operation
original: Comrades, let us keep to the plan.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Leave it to me.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Is it my turn?

title: Deployment 1
original: Stay calm, relax…

title: Deployment 2
original: First, remember the combat manual…

title: In Battle 1
original: Ready, aim... FIRE!

title: In Battle 2
original: Huh? A misfire? Eek!

title: In Battle 3
original: Rosa, believe in yourself. You can do it!

title: In Battle 4
original: This is nothing personal...

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, we did it...! Oh, um, ahem, truly a delightful victory!

title: 3-star Result
original: I hope I've met Doctor's expectations.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: My apologies, Doctor. If only I had tried harder...

title: Operation Failure
original: We must review this carefully after we get back…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I wonder if there's anywhere quite like the salon?

title: Tap
original: Oh!

title: Trust Tap
original: Another lovely day today.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy new year, Doctor. This is a busy day, but I'm glad that I can contribute towards the party. I hope everyone likes my floral arrangements and desserts. Oh, I just remembered something. The USSG and I will be hosting a small private gathering this evening. You're more than welcome to join us, Doctor.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, it's great to see you.

title: Birthday
original: We had to be extremely careful with our gifts at school. A slight mistake may just trigger a sizable scandal. But that's something I no longer need to worry about, and I can express myself however I wish. Happy birthday, Doctor. Gummy taught me how to bake these cookies. Thank you for taking care of us.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I may never be able to free myself from the nightmare. But since my arrival at Rhodes Island, I gradually found the courage to face it. It's all thanks to you and my friends at the USSG. You always stand by my side and lead the way... I believe one day, I will finally be able to start my life anew.
